description: The accepted frame route: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 draws the character from a model sheet, posed by a bare skeleton or by words. Per-pose workflows carry their prompt baked in, since the host's prompt override did not reach this node (2001-stpr).

prompts.skeleton: Image 2 is a coloured stick-figure pose skeleton. Draw the {noun} from image 1 standing in that exact pose, at the same size and position in the frame as the skeleton, with empty background around {obj}: {poss} whole figure fits inside the frame, {fits} fully visible with margin on every side. {description}. {props}Sides are {poss} own: {sub} {faces} the viewer, so {poss} left is on the right of the picture. {Sub} {keeps} {poss} {look}, exactly as in image 1. Same pixel art style with crisp pixel clusters and cel shading. {Sub} {has} exactly two arms and two hands, each hand complete with fingers. {extra}Do not draw the skeleton. Plain light grey background, full body.
